create_DCGMProfiler: create a DCGMProfiler instance to profile GPU metrics using NVIDIA DCGM with specified GPUs and field IDs
build_dcgm_group: build a DCGM GPU group from a tuple of GPU IDs, validating against supported GPUs on the system
get_profilable_fields: get the set of field IDs that can be profiled on the configured DCGM GPU group
create_profiling_field_group: create a DCGM field group from a tuple of field IDs, filtering to only profilable fields
run_DCGMProfiler_step: run the DCGMProfiler step method to collect and log averaged GPU profiling metrics to the main profiler summary
